Senior Python engineer role on ComboCurve's cloud platform for energy-sector asset evaluation and economics, writing calculation logic over structured time series data along with the APIs and services around it. The work covers features end-to-end, from design through deployment and monitoring on GCP. Core stack is Python 3.13+ with async, Flask/FastAPI, REST and gRPC, MongoDB, pandas and numpy, Docker, and GCP services like Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, and GCS.
